liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Must Have Been the Roses** (4 reviews): Reviewer found this one awesome; The drummers stepped on the delicate melody, spoiling an otherwise decent version [10][12][14][15]
- **Eyes of The World** (3 reviews): The Eyes, Eternity, He's Gone run is nice but somewhat sleepy [12][14][15]
- **The Days Between** (1 review): Haunting version out of Space; Jerry played well on point but forgot some lyrics [10]

## Setlist highlights

- **Fireworks (Hendrix: Star Spangled Banner)**: rare: 8 archived performances [17]

## The recordings

- **gd1994-07-24.112820.bk.schmit.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 22 songs; 190 min; rated 2.33/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd94-07-24.aud.candyman.10087.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 20 songs; 182 min; rated 3.38/5 by 8 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer considers this a good audience recording [7]
- **gd1994-07-24.akgc391.cohen.lee.119591.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 182 min; rated 3/5 by 3 [3]
- **gd1994-07-24.147692.schoepsCMC5MK4.ebel.flac1648**: source not stated; 19 songs; 182 min [4]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says this was their final Dead show, and felt the performance was fairly rushed [6]
- Reviewer was fifteen and stood thirteen rows back on Jerry's side of the stage [7]
- Recalls Billy hitting so hard in Drums that he tossed his sticks and nearly ran offstage, though unsure which Soldier Field night [9]
- Reviewer felt the band was in decline by this point, with Jerry seeming not fully present [6]
- Disagrees that the show was rushed; at times the band could have picked up the pace [8]
- Reviewer, who attended over 85 shows, rates it above most 1980s shows they saw [8]
- Decent for 1994 and well played, but laid back to the point of lethargy [12]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1994-07-24.112820.bk.schmit.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Alan Schmit; transferred by Terry Watts; source: Source: (ORTF/110^/DFC/FOB) B&K 4011s > Neumann BS48i-2 > Modified Sony TCD-D10 Pro > DAT(m); [1]. Also: Liberty sits at the end of the Set I DAT, so there is a cut during the encore break; Set II and its encore are tracked seamlessly, so listeners can burn the discs as they like [1]
- **gd94-07-24.aud.candyman.10087.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Paul B.; source: Audience: Unknown Mics [2]
- **gd1994-07-24.akgc391.cohen.lee.119591.flac16**: taped by Dave Cohen and Justin Lee; source: AKG C391 ORTF in hat FOB 18th row Left Center>Teac DAP20 @ 16/48; DAT Master>Lynx Studio 1>Wavelab 3.0; Weiss Saracon SRC (all sample rate conversions). FLAC'd… [3]
- **gd1994-07-24.147692.schoepsCMC5MK4.ebel.flac1648**: transferred by Pete Ebel; source: FOB Schoeps CMC5 Mk 4-> Aerco P/S-> Panasonic SV255-> DAT [4]
